name: Android
text: Androids are synthetic humanoids built with artificial bodies but living minds. Now recognized as persons, they often struggle with questions of identity and belonging. They gain low-light vision and a +1 bonus to saves against diseases, poisons, and radiation.

name: Astrazoan
text: Amorphous shapeshifters capable of mimicking any humanoid form, astrazoans are consummate performers and infiltrators. They can alter their appearance at will and have a fly speed of 30 feet in their natural form. They gain low-light vision.

name: Azarketi
text: Gill-bearing aquatic humanoids descended from the ancient Azlanti people, azarketis are equally at home in water and on land. They gain a swim speed of 30 feet, can breathe both air and water, and have low-light vision.

name: Bantrid
text: Small wheeled beings that roll rather than walk, bantrids are curious and energetic explorers from a windswept world. Their wheel-based locomotion gives them exceptional speed on flat terrain but difficulty on stairs. They gain darkvision.

name: Barathu
text: Floating gas-bag beings from the planet Bretheda, barathus are communal creatures capable of merging with one another to share knowledge and abilities. They have a fly speed of 30 feet and can merge with willing barathus for brief periods.

name: Brenneri
text: Otter-like humanoids who are deeply empathic and socially attuned, brenneris are natural diplomats. Their acute senses and quick reflexes make them excellent scouts. They gain darkvision and a swim speed of 20 feet.

name: Catfolk
text: Agile and curious feline humanoids who follow their instincts across the galaxy, catfolk are natural hunters with sharp senses. They gain low-light vision and a +2 circumstance bonus to initiative checks using Stealth.

name: Contemplative
text: Floating psychic beings of pure mental energy, contemplatives rarely touch the ground. They communicate telepathically and excel at intellectual and mystical pursuits. They have a fly speed of 30 feet. They have low-light vision.

name: Copaxi
text: Sturdy crystalline beings from a tidally locked world, copaxis communicate through bioluminescent patterns and harmonic tones. Their crystalline bodies provide natural resistance. They gain resistance 2 to electricity and sonic damage.

name: Dragonet
text: Small draconic beings who retain the pride and potential of their larger dragon kin, dragonets are rare but memorable. They have wings giving a fly speed of 20 feet and a breath weapon usable once per day. They gain darkvision.

name: Dragonkin
text: Powerful draconic humanoids who share ancestry with true dragons, dragonkin carry scales, claws, and a breath weapon. They gain darkvision and resistance 5 to the energy type matching their draconic heritage.

name: Dwarf
text: Stocky and resilient, dwarves are known for their craftsmanship, stubbornness, and deep spiritual connection to the earth. In the modern era many serve as engineers and miners across the Pact Worlds. They gain darkvision.

name: Elebrian
text: The original inhabitants of Eox before the planet's devastation, elebrians now exist mostly as undead. Living elebrians are rare scholars who survived in magitech stasis. They gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Recall Knowledge.

name: Elf
text: Ancient and perceptive, elves have adapted to the modern galaxy while maintaining their connection to nature and art. Known for their long lifespans and acute senses, elves excel as scholars and explorers. They gain low-light vision.

name: Entu Colony
text: Fungal colony organisms that present a unified consciousness through a network of mycelial threads, entu colonies can extend their awareness through nearby spores. They gain tremorsense 30 feet and resistance 2 to poison.

name: Fonqugon
text: Massive gelatinous beings from a cold world, fonqugons are slow but remarkably tough. Their semi-liquid bodies can absorb impacts and squeeze through tight spaces. They gain resistance 5 to cold damage and can fit through spaces one size smaller. They have low-light vision.

name: Formian
text: Insectoid beings organized in colony structures, formians are disciplined workers and soldiers. Their exoskeletons provide natural armor and their hive-mind heritage gives them exceptional coordination. They gain a +1 circumstance bonus to initiative. They have low-light vision.

name: G'folian
text: Psychic gastropod beings who ride in shells that serve as both homes and tools, g'folians are patient thinkers with remarkable mental gifts. They gain telepathy 30 feet and can deliver touch spells at range 10 feet. They have low-light vision.

name: Gnarefuroid
text: Junkyard scavengers turned social spacefarers, gnarefuroids incorporate salvaged technology directly into their bodies. They have low-light vision and a climb Speed of 15 feet. As Stowaways they can survive clinging to inhospitable surfaces, adding a month to the time before starvation or thirst penalties set in.

name: Gnome
text: Curious and energetic, gnomes throw themselves into whatever they find interesting. Modern gnomes are often inventors, artists, or adventurers driven by an insatiable need for novelty. They gain low-light vision.

name: Goblin
text: Small, impulsive, and surprisingly dangerous, goblins have leveraged their chaotic energy and technological aptitude in the modern era. They love fire, explosions, and anything shiny. They gain darkvision.

name: Halfling
text: Small but resourceful, halflings are expert survivors with remarkable luck. An innate wanderlust has spread them across the galaxy as traders, scouts, and adventurers.

name: Hobgoblin
text: Militaristic and disciplined goblinoids who have carved out a place in the Pact Worlds through sheer determination and organization, hobgoblins excel as soldiers and tacticians. They gain darkvision.

name: Human
text: Adaptable and tenacious, humans are the most widespread ancestry in the Pact Worlds. They receive two free attribute boosts and excel at any role.

name: Ijtikri
text: Spider-like beings with eight limbs and a patient, web-weaving culture, ijtikri are skilled crafters and patient hunters. They can spin webs and climb at full speed. They gain darkvision and a climb speed of 25 feet.

name: Ikeshti
text: Amphibious reptilian beings from Akiton, ikeshti are survivors of a brutal world. They are fiercely independent, scavenging what they need and trusting few outside their rivik (bonded group). They gain a swim speed of 30 feet.

name: Izalguun
text: Dinosaur-like hunters from a prehistoric world, izalguuns combine raw physical power with an instinct-driven approach to survival. Their powerful jaws and thick hide make them formidable in close quarters. They gain darkvision.

name: Kalo
text: Shark-like aquatic beings from a water world, kalos are graceful swimmers and skilled hunters. Their sharp senses detect electrical fields. They gain a swim speed of 30 feet, can breathe water, and gain blindsense (electricity) 30 feet. They have darkvision.

name: Kasatha
text: Four-armed nomads who hail from the desert world of Kasath. Deeply philosophical and bound by tradition, they have traveled to the Pact Worlds seeking purpose. Their four arms allow them to hold and wield up to four hands' worth of weapons.

name: Khizar
text: Intelligent ambulatory plants who combine an ancient biological heritage with remarkable cognitive ability, khizars are scholars and mystics. They gain resistance 5 to poison, don't need to sleep, and can sustain themselves through photosynthesis.

name: Kholo
text: Hyena-like humanoids with a distinctive cackling laugh and powerful jaws, kholos are social creatures who thrive in groups. Their bite is capable of crushing bone. They gain a jaws Strike (1d6 piercing) and low-light vision.

name: Kobold
text: Small draconic beings who claim kinship with true dragons and have spread across the galaxy following draconic patrons, kobolds are cunning trappers and pack tacticians. They gain darkvision and a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls when flanking.

name: Lashunta
text: Psychic humanoids from the jungle world of Castrovel. Lashuntas exhibit strong telepathic ability and come in two physical forms: Damaya (scholarly) and Korasha (warrior).

name: Leshy
text: Tiny plant beings animated by nature spirits, leshies take the form of various plants — seeds, fungi, cacti, and more. They are tied to natural cycles. They gain low-light vision, resistance 5 to poison, and don't need to eat or drink.

name: Lizardfolk
text: Ancient reptilian beings with a strong connection to their ancestral homeland, lizardfolk have adapted to the modern galaxy while preserving their traditions. They gain a swim speed of 20 feet and a tail Strike (1d6 bludgeoning).

name: Madrosarai
text: Multi-limbed beings who excel at fine manipulation and technical work, madrosarai are natural engineers. Their six arms allow them to work on multiple tasks simultaneously. They can hold and use up to three two-handed items at once.

name: Maraquoi
text: Large woolly beings from a cold world who communicate through infrasonic hums inaudible to most species, maraquois are powerful and perceptive. Their dense fur resists cold. They gain resistance 5 to cold damage and low-light vision.

name: Moyishuu
text: Tall beings with four eyes and an innate gift for chronomancy, moyishuus experience time slightly differently from other species. They can glimpse the immediate future. Once per day, they can reroll an attack or skill check before the result is announced.

name: Novian
text: Coral-like colonial beings who grow and evolve throughout their lives, novians are living reefs capable of incorporating biological and technological upgrades into their bodies. They gain resistance 2 to acid and can install one additional augmentation in any slot.

name: Nuar
text: Distant, smaller cousins of minotaurs, nuars are calm problem-solvers whose home and history were lost to the Gap. They have darkvision and a horns unarmed attack dealing 1d8 piercing damage in the brawling group. As Gravitational Adepts they ignore the usual penalties while in zero gravity.

name: Orc
text: Powerful and fierce, orcs have overcome their warlike reputation to carve out diverse roles across the Pact Worlds. Their physical prowess and tenacity make them exceptional warriors and laborers. They gain darkvision.

name: Orocoran
text: Eyeless ambush predators who hunt by scent and vibration, ororocans are feared hunters adapted to pitch-black environments. They gain blindsense (scent) 60 feet, darkvision, and a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks in darkness or dim light.

name: Osharu
text: Snail-like beings who carry their shell-homes on their backs, osharus are patient and methodical. Their shells provide significant natural protection. They gain a +2 item bonus to AC from natural armor and can retract into their shell as a single action. They have darkvision.

name: Pahtra
text: Lithe feline humanoids from the tidally locked world of Vesk-6, pahtra are known for their grace, quick reflexes, and rich musical traditions. Their culture prizes individual excellence and artistic achievement. They gain darkvision.

name: Raxilite
text: Tiny sapient plants who resemble seedpods or small floating bulbs, raxilites are extraordinarily intelligent botanist-philosophers. Their tiny size lets them hide easily and access tight spaces. They gain a fly speed of 15 feet and low-light vision.

name: Ryphorian
text: The dominant ancestry of Triaxus, ryphorians naturally shift between Summerborn and Winterborn forms. Known for their adaptability to extreme climates, they make skilled explorers and soldiers. They gain low-light vision.

name: Samsaran
text: Reincarnating mystic beings who carry memories across multiple lifetimes, samsarans are deeply spiritual and possess echoes of skills from past lives. They gain a +1 circumstance bonus to one Recall Knowledge check per day as a memory surfaces. They have low-light vision.

name: Sarcesian
text: Ethereal giants native to the Diaspora asteroid belt, sarcessians have adapted to zero-gravity environments with natural flight. They are renowned artisans and traders. They have a fly speed of 30 feet.

name: Shirren
text: Insectoid beings who recently broke free from the Swarm's hive mind. Shirrens value individual choice and personal freedom, communicating via limited telepathy.

name: Shobhad
text: Towering four-armed warriors from the deserts of Akiton, shobhads are formidable combatants who live by a strict code of honor and self-reliance. Their four arms allow them to wield multiple weapons simultaneously.

name: Skittermander
text: Small six-armed furred beings who were once part of the Veskarium. Skittermanders are relentlessly helpful and enthusiastic, driven by an instinct to assist those around them. They have low-light vision.

name: Talphi
text: Rabbit-like beings with enormous ears and exceptional hearing, talphis are alert and quick. Their powerful legs allow impressive leaps. They gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks involving hearing and a 10-foot leap.

name: Tengu
text: Crow-like humanoids with quick tongues and quicker wits, tengus are gifted mimics and linguists who have spread across the galaxy following opportunity. They gain low-light vision and can mimic voices and sounds they have heard.

name: Tripkee
text: Frog-like beings who use their sticky tongues and adhesive toes to navigate any surface, tripkees are nimble survivors. They gain a climb speed of 20 feet, can use their tongue as a manipulate limb at range 10 feet, and gain low-light vision.

name: Trox
text: Massive insectoid beings from the planet Nchak, trox are physically imposing and unfailingly loyal. Despite their fearsome appearance, they are devoted to their companions and followers of Hylax. They gain a natural grapple attack. They have darkvision.

name: Urog
text: Massive crystalline beings native to the gas giant Dykon, urogs are slow but incredibly durable. Their crystalline bodies provide natural armor and resistance to sonic damage. They gain resistance 5 to sonic damage. They have darkvision. The Intelligence boost may instead be taken as Wisdom.

name: Verthani
text: Elegant three-eyed humanoids from Verces, verthani are renowned artists and observers. Their third eye grants exceptional perception and the ability to see through illusions. They gain a +2 bonus to Perception.

name: Vesk
text: Reptilian warriors from the Veskarium, vesk value strength, honor, and martial excellence above all else. Their thick scales provide natural protection. They gain low-light vision.

name: Vlaka
text: Canine humanoids from the frozen world of Lajok, vlakas are empathic and community-oriented. Many are deaf or blind and rely on alternative senses. They gain blindsense (emotion) 30 feet.

name: Vulkarisu
text: Curious fox-squirrel humanoids from Castrovel with a talent for languages, vulkarisu are often mistaken for squoxes. They have low-light vision and a climb Speed of 15 feet (burrow-sworn trade this for a burrow Speed). Land on Your Feet halves the damage from a fall and keeps them upright.

name: Witchwyrd
text: Four-armed blue-skinned traders and mages, witchwyrds traveled the multiverse long before others mastered drift travel. They can absorb magical energy as a reaction once per day and redirect it.

name: Woioko
text: Aquatic humanoids adapted to ocean worlds, woiokos are graceful and curious. Their vibrant bioluminescent markings communicate mood and intent. They gain a swim speed of 30 feet.

name: Worlanisi
text: Six-armed diminutive beings who are natural gamblers and statisticians, worlanisis have an instinctive grasp of probability. They can use all six arms independently. Once per day, they can treat any die roll as if they had rolled their average result. They have low-light vision.

name: Ysoki
text: Small ratfolk traders and tinkerers, ysoki are curious and resourceful. Their cheek pouches, sharp wits, and nimble fingers make them natural mechanics and thieves. They have low-light vision.
